extension.description: Unified VS Code build and flash workflow for STC MCUs, with legacy stcgal support, official-tool fallback and experimental native USB HID.
config.title: STC Toolkit
config.projectFile.description: Keil .uvproj/.uvprojx project path. Leave empty to detect automatically.
config.keilUv4Path.description: Path to Keil UV4.exe used for C51/C251 builds. Example only: C:\Path\To\Keil_v5\UV4\UV4.exe
config.buildCustomCommand.description: Optional custom build command. Leave empty to use Keil UV4.exe. Supports ${workspaceFolder} and ${projectFile}.
config.firmwareFile.description: Optional firmware override. Leave empty to automatically detect HEX/IHX from the Keil project output and workspace.
config.flashBackend.description: Programming backend. Auto is recommended and selects a suitable backend from the detected MCU family.
config.flashBackend.auto: Automatically select a backend from the detected MCU family.
config.flashBackend.stcgal: Use stcgal for legacy/common STC UART ISP devices.
config.flashBackend.nativeHid: Use the experimental direct USB-HID backend. Large-address devices are intentionally protected until verified.
config.flashBackend.official: Open the configured official STC-ISP/AiCube tool. Recommended for newer or large-flash devices currently unsupported by native HID.
config.flashBackend.custom: Run your own custom flashing command.
config.stcgalPath.description: stcgal executable or command. Keep 'stcgal' when it is available in PATH.
config.flashProtocol.description: Optional stcgal protocol override. Keep Auto unless you know the exact protocol required by your MCU.
config.flashPort.description: Serial port for UART ISP, for example COM3. Not required for USB-only backends.
config.flashBaud.description: Programming baud rate used by stcgal UART mode.
config.flashAutoreset.description: Pass -a to stcgal to use DTR/RTS auto reset when supported by the programmer hardware.
config.pythonPath.description: Python executable/command used by the experimental native HID helper. Leave empty to detect automatically.
config.nativeHidExperimental.description: Enable the experimental direct USB-HID ISP backend. It currently rejects firmware addresses above 0xFFFF for safety.
config.nativeHidAutoReset.description: Before native HID flashing, try to send the configured reset-to-ISP command to VID 34BF / PID FF01.
config.nativeHidResetCommand.description: Command sent to the running user firmware to request entry into ISP mode. Default: @STCISP#
config.officialIspPath.description: Path to the official STC-ISP or AiCube executable. Example only: C:\Path\To\STC-ISP\STC-ISP-v6.96S.exe
config.showEditorButtons.description: Show Build, Flash and Build & Flash buttons in the editor title bar for C/C++ files.
config.showSuccessNotifications.descript: Show success notifications after build/flash. Disable for a quieter one-click workflow.
config.firmwareAutoDetect.description: Automatically detect firmware from Keil OutputDirectory/OutputName and common build folders. Recommended.
config.preferFreshBuild.description: After Build, prefer firmware created or updated by the current build to avoid flashing a stale HEX file.
